raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W2W3W) Slow to begin, raced at the tail of the field over 10Ls off the fast pace, had big task in hand 400M, made up some ground without troubling the leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W2W3W) 出閘緩慢，居馬群尾列，落後步速甚快的領放馬逾十個馬位。四百米處落後甚多。略為追前，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, held up and never able to be fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。末段受困，從未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Impeded leaving stalls, held up last, had to wait for run turning into home straight, twice short of room when trying to improve in home straight, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時受阻，留居包尾位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。直路上在嘗試推進之際兩度空位不足。跑來欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) From draw 3 dropped back to race near last, kept to inside throughout, closed off quite well to go 2nd close home without troubling the winner. (Jockey fined for returning 3 lbs overweight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 自第三檔出閘，墮後至接近包尾位置。沿途走內疊。末段衝刺頗佳，接近終點時進佔第二位，但未能威脅頭馬。（騎師因返回覆磅時超磅三磅而被罰款。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, unable to secure clear run until final 100m, not fully extended.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。未能望空直至一百米處。未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Showed no early pace and settled to be the last few on the rail, briefly held up in the last 100M, travelled strongly to the line, did not disgrace at all.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 欠缺前速，居最後數位之內，走內欄。最後一百米一度受困。以勁勢衝刺至終點。表現不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, driven 400m out to chase leaders, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處在催策下追趕領先馬匹。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Taken back to race towards rear on the outside, moved closer on turn, closed off well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 留居後列，走外疊。直路彎追近。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Raced towards rear, late headway but never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後列。末段略為追前，但從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (2W1W2W4W) Rail position in mid-field, good headway final bend, stayed on well in home straight but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(2W1W2W4W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎追前甚多。直路上保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W2W2W3W) Sat handy, made good ground over the concluding stages, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W2W2W3W) 居前列。末段追前甚多，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Mid-field, ridden along 500m out, some headway early in home straight, unable to sustain and weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。五百米處受催策。直路初略為追前。最後一百米無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W2W4W) Settled in midfield in 6th mainly some 4L back, commenced move on top of home bend swinging widest into straight, ran on under pressure to hit the front briefly 150M out only to be caught close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W2W4W) 主要居中間第六位，落後約四個馬位。直路彎早段開始上前。入直路時移出最外疊。在催策下上前，一百五十米處一度取得領先，僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Taken back from gate 10, raced 2 wide towards rear, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, finished off well to make frame without threatening the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 自第十檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。衝刺良佳，取得第四名，但未能威脅首三名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W3W3W) Sent forward from high draw, caught wide without cover, forced wider 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策上前，走外疊，沒有遮擋。三百米處被迫移出更外疊。轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Settled midfield 2 wide, took sometime to respond, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。花了一些時間才對催策交出反應。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Pressed leader, dropped to track leaders middle stages, driven along to chase leaders 400m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 追迫領放馬。中段墮後，跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Settled towards rear on rail, steadied behind runners and lost position between the 900 and 700M, renewed effort rounding home bend saving ground into straight, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。九百米處至七百米處之間在馬群之後收慢，失位。直路彎重新發力，入直路時走內欄節省腳程。末段再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, under pressure to hold position 600m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。六百米處在催策下保持位置，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, struggled to hold position final bend, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎難以保持位置。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, chased along final bend, ran on well final 200m to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎追趕對手。最後二百米走勢良佳，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W2W) Sat on pace, raced keenly early, no contention (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 居前列。早段搶口。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Chased leaders, raced keenly in the early stages, driven along nearing 400M but soon couldn't keep up with leaders. Out of contention mid-straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 追趕領先馬匹。早段搶口。接近四百米處時受催策，但瞬即未能跟上領先馬匹。直路中段再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W2W) Bumped out of stalls, chased leader, ridden to press leader 500m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，追趕領放馬。五百米處受催策，追迫領放馬。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W1W) Gradually took up running obtaining rails run 1300M out, led the field until headed 150M out, kept on for a place at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 逐漸取得領先，千三米處移入內欄。持續領先，直至一百五十米處被超越。保持走勢，過終點時跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W1W1W) Jumped well, raced in 2nd, 2-1/2L back turning in, showed good response in straight, hit the front 200M, kept on strongly to the line, won by 3 lengths.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居第二位。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。直路上對催策反應良佳。二百米處取得領先。保持勁勢至終點，以三個馬位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked the leader, raced keenly in the early stages, gave ground passing 200M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。早段搶口。跑過二百米處時墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W2W2W) Wide early, improved to chase leader after 600m, unable to match that rival home straight but stuck on to hold second, edged right.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W2W2W) 早段走外疊。過了六百米處後上前追趕領放馬。直路上不敵該對手，持續力拼，保持居第二位。末段向內斜跑。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Settled in last few for rails run from a wide barrier, commenced move entering home straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘，居最後數位之內，走內欄。入直路時開始上前。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, ridden top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。直路初受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W) Waited with towards rear, raced keenly throughout, dropped to last place top of home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W) 居後列，留力候上。沿途搶口。直路初墮退至包尾位置，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Stayed close enough to leaders throughout, worked into the race well passing 400M but couldn't muster enough mid-straight and weakened out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 沿途保持緊隨領先馬匹。跑過四百米處時以佳勢上前，但直路中段加速力不足。轉弱，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Dipped at start before settling just over 2L back in 4th on rail, angled out 500M out for a run into straight, tightened and lost position 200M out and ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘時將頭低俯，其後居第四位，落後稍逾兩個馬位，走內欄。五百米處向外移出，入直路時取得空位。二百米處受緊迫及失位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, settled in rear of mid-field, ridden along 600m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。六百米處受催策。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, switched out in the Straight, ran on nicely, just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路上向外移出。末段以佳勢上前，僅保住冠軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, struggled to hold position on bend, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎難以保持位置。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Raced wide in mid-field, headway into contention 200m out, stayed on between horses despite being tight for room.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。二百米處上前爭勝。儘管在馬匹之間受緊迫，但保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed very good response in straight, took the lead approaching 150M, kept on very well to the line, easily scored.
(Lost left hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上對催策反應甚佳。趨近一百五十米處時取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點。從容取勝。
（失去左後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W1W1W) Held up last from wide draw, still plenty to do 300m out, stayed towards rail, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。三百米處仍落後甚遠，保持走內欄。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Sat handy, slightly weakened passing the 200M, closed off okay (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列。跑過二百米處時略為轉弱。末段衝刺尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, waited with in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W3W5W) From draw 13 unable to slot in, raced 3-wide without cover in midfield throughout, couldn't keep up with rivals passing 250M, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W3W5W) 自第十三檔出閘後未能切入，沿途居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑過二百五十米處時未能跟上對手，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Slightly slow out and bumped, raced at tail, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘稍慢，被碰撞，居包尾位置。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled in the second half of the field on the rail throughout, failed to make any impression in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後半馬群中。沿途走內欄。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, forced wider top of home straight, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間位疊，走第三疊。直路初被迫移出更外疊。保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (2W1W2W1W) Tracked leader, made effort and in share of lead turning into home straight, no extra and faded final 150m.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(2W1W2W1W) 跟隨領放馬。轉入直路時發力上前，並排領先。最後一百五十米再無餘力及力竭。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) From draw 3 settled down in midfield along the inside, couldn't go on turning into straight, weakened rapidly to finish tailed out. (Unacceptable Performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第三檔出閘，居中間位置，走內疊。轉入直路時無以為繼。其後迅速轉弱，包尾大敗而回。（表現難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W1W) Gradually settled at the back from a wide barrier, detached from over 500M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，逐漸留居後列。自五百米處起被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W1W) Settled in mid-field, keen early stages, ridden to hold position 900m out, outpaced and left behind in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W1W) 居中間位置。早段搶口。九百米處受催策以保持位置。直路上未能跟上步速，被拋離。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Reserved in mid-division 5Ls off the pace before keeping on steadily over final 300M to take 4th. (Jockey fined for returning to scale 2 lbs overweight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 留居中間位置，落後領放馬五個馬位。最後三百米保持穩勢，取得第四名。（騎師因返回覆磅時超磅兩磅而被罰款。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W1W) Gradually settled in midfield, drifted further back when tempo increased 800M out, never recovered.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W1W) 逐漸居中間位置。八百米處步速加快時進一步墮退。從未能收復失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W1W) Crowded and bumped at start, raced in rear, still in rear top of home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫及發生碰撞，居後列。直路初仍居後列。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Raced in rear after checked 1100m out, under pressure from 700m out to hold position, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 千一米處勒避，其後居後列。自七百米處起受催策以保持位置。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, bumped 1000m out, under pressure on bend to chase leaders, left behind home straight, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。一千米處發生碰撞。直路彎在催策下追趕領先馬匹。直路上被拋離，所負甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Taken back from the outside barrier, sat towards the rear on the rail, made minor headway late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Travelled keenly at times mainly 3-wide without cover in midfield, circled the field home bend to be widest in 6th some 2L back into straight, soon found no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 大多居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋，不時搶口。直路彎繞過馬群。入直路時居第六位，落後約兩個馬位，走最外疊。瞬即再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Towards rear, wide into home straight, stayed on late, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列。入直路時走外疊。末段保持走勢，未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, nothing in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Sat midfield on the rail, stayed on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。末段保持佳勢。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W3W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced 3 wide better than midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Sat outside the lead, nothing extra final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W) 居前列。走勢不俗。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W1W1W) Involved in early battle for lead, chased leader until no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W1W1W) 早段爭奪領先。追趕領放馬，直至最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, pushed along final bend to chase leaders, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路彎受推策，追趕領先馬匹。保持佳勢，但未能與頭馬抗衡。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置﹐走第二疊。未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走勢普通。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (1W1W) Jumped well from draw 10 and was obliged to take up the lead to avoid being caught wide, lay out in the Home Straight proving difficult to ride out, had no more to offer 200M.
Jockey dropped whip 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(1W1W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，須領放以免走外疊。直路上外閃，難以被力策。二百米處再無餘力。
騎師於一百米處跌掉馬鞭。
runnerrecords.incident_chi: 騎師於一百米處跌掉馬鞭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made some headway in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W5W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Tracked leaders, ridden 300m out, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處受催策。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, rear of mid-field towards centre of course, effort 400m out, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。四百米處發力。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Behind early after slow start, in mid-division by halfway, short of room when trying to improve 350m out, stayed on once clear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，早段居後列。半程前居中間位置。三百五十米處在嘗試推進之際空位不足。最後二百米望空後隨即保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Moderately away, positioned a length behind the leader, hard ridden from 400M, peaked 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘普通，落後領放馬一個馬位。自四百米處起受力策。二百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped on jumping, raced behind midfield on the middle track, made some progress after passing 300M, peaked on run 150M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;躍出時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，在跑道中央競跑。跑過三百米處後略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) Tracked leaders, travelled smoothly and well placed, under pressure 400m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)跟隨領先馬匹。走勢暢順，居好位。四百米處受催策，保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Began awkwardly, raced 3 wide in midfield, there to turn, finished off well but always just held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段衝刺良佳，但一直稍為落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Slightly slow out, raced 3 wide behind midfield, difficult to settle in the early stages, 3 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘稍慢，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。早段難以穩定走勢。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W3W) Awkward start, settled in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on well and lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。以佳勢上前，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Inconvenienced at start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 起步時受妨礙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, 6 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Ridden forward early from wide draw but unable to hold position, soon in rear, wide into home straight, stayed on, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘，早段在催策下上前，但未能保持位置，瞬即墮居後列。入直路時走外疊。保持走勢，從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Away well, tracked leaders on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 450M, kept on well in straight to take 2nd, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速。跟隨領先馬匹，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。四百五十米處向外移出。直路上保持佳勢，取得亞軍，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, made some minor ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, never a threat. (See Incident Report)
(Lost left hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）
（失去左後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat towards the rear, hung out and never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列。外閃，從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast(+) (4W2W3W) Held up from wide draw, still last top of home straight when short of room briefly, stayed on between horses.
(Jockey dropped whip at 100M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速(+)(4W2W3W) 自外檔出閘，留後。直路初仍居包尾位置，一度空位不足。在馬匹之間保持走勢。
（騎師於一百米處跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (5W1W1W) Sat rear, made the turn wide, not much ground made in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(5W1W1W) 居包尾位置。轉直路彎時走外疊。直路上追前不多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Began well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Made contact shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Moderately away from gate 8, raced prominently on the outside, 1/4L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自第八檔出閘普通，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後四分一個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Slowly away, rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, stayed on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Commenced well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, travelled well to turn, challenged the leader after turning in, hit the front 100M, kept on well to the line and scored.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前走勢良佳。入直路後挑戰領放馬。一百米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，掄元。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Average to begin, raced 3 wide in midfield, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第三疊，沿途沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced better than midfield but trapped 3 wide, travelled keenly, moved closer after passing 700M, no cover throughout, made some progress early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居中間之前位置，但走第三疊，搶口。跑過七百米處後追近。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Commenced well, sent forward to take the lead, shared lead turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened inside final furlong.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時並排領先。三百米處未能再增速及被超越。最後二百米轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Raced in touch with leaders, under pressure 400m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Ridden hard to lead, traveled okay, weakened passing the 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 在力策下取得領先，走勢尚可。跑過二百五十米處時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Fast into stride, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well in the middle stages, headed near 300M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展步迅速，受催策上前領放。中段走勢良佳，接近三百米處時被超越，最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, tired closing stages and headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。末段呈現疲態，接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Fast break, made all, quickened top of home straight, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，一直領放。直路初加速。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, good headway on bend, ridden top of home straight to challenge leader, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎以佳勢上前。直路初在催策下挑戰領放馬。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden hard to lead, slightly weakened passing 200M
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 在力策下領放。跑過二百米處時略為轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on evenly to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along from stalls to track leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, weakened quickly home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘後受催策，沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Pressed forward to reach 2nd making first turn, chased the leaders into home straight holding every chance until finding no extra inside final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 首次轉彎時在催策下上前，居第二位。入直路時追趕領先馬匹。一度甚具爭勝機會，直至五十米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W3W3W) Tracked pace, raced wide to final bend, improved to hold every chance 150m out, no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬。直路彎前走外疊。一百五十米處上前，一度甚具爭勝機會。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W2W) Jumped well from the widest draw, sent forward to race in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked on run 350M, weakened early in straight, eased inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。三百五十米處未能再增速。直路初轉弱。最後二百米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, weakened inside 250M, never a threat (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在催策下取得領先。最後二百五十米轉弱。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W2W) Chased leader, challenged turning into home straight, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 追趕領放馬。轉入直路時展開挑戰。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race at rear, 5 to 6 lengths back, same margin back on turn, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久發生觸碰。留居後列，落後五至六個馬位。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, ran on strongly to lead close home and hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。其後以勁勢上前，接近終點時取得領先，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Mid division, under pressure 600m out, switched wide for clear run 400m out, short-lived effort 200m out, unable to sustain.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策。四百米處移出外疊以望空。二百米處一度發力，其後無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W1W) Began awkwardly and made contact, sent forward to take the early lead, headed 1100M, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，早段受催策上前，取得領先。千一米處被超越。中段落後領放馬一至兩個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to track leaders, unable to pick up for pressure from 500m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策以跟隨領先馬匹。自五百米處起受催策，未能加速。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Chased the leader, gave ground passing the 300M, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬。跑過三百米處時墮退。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, sent forward to take the lead, shared lead with rival turning in, peaked and headed 200M, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，受催策上前領放。入直路時與對手並排領先。二百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Sat behind the lead, nothing extra in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 居領放馬之後。直路上再無餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W1W1W) Ridden to soon take up running onto back straight setting a sound pace, led the field until finding no extra over 200M out, lost a placing late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W1W1W) 受催策，進入對面直路時瞬即取得領先，以快步速領放。保持領先直至二百米處再無餘力。末段失去季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W) Made running and set fast pace, challenged from 150m out, responded well, headed only close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W) 以快步速領放。自一百五十米處起受挑戰。對催策反應良佳，僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well and led on the rail, kept on until weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，沿欄領放。保持走勢直至最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Sat handy, traveled greenly, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居前列。走勢稚嫩。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced in 2nd, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居第二位。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, same position on turn, took the lead 300M, peaked and headed approaching 100M, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。三百米處取得領先。趨近一百米處時未能再增速及被超越，其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, switched for clear run top of home straight, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初轉換跑線以望空。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, tracked leaders against rail, challenged and every chance from 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, taken wider on bend, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎移出較外疊。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Wide with leaders from a poor draw, shifted over 1L back to 4th rounding home bend, kept on without quickening after straightening and faded under pressure inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自第十二檔出閘，與領先馬匹並排，走外疊。轉直路彎時墮後逾一個馬位，居第四位。入直路後保持走勢，未能加速。最後一百米在催策下力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Raced in rear of mid-field, switched for clear run 300m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Sat in front of midfield, had difficulty obtaining clear running entering the Straight, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置。入直路時難以望空。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, under pressure to hold position from 650m out, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。自六百五十米處起在催策下保持位置。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W4W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, wide throughout, pushed along widest into home straight, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W4W) 早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。沿途走外疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W2W4W) Bumped shortly after start, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, very wide into straight, finished off very strongly to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W2W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺凌厲，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 400M, unable to obtain clear run in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。跑過四百米處後向外移出。直路上未能望空。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, forced to steady on heels 900m out, improved to rear of mid-field 700m out, lost balance on bend and 250m out, faded final.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後墮退，九百米處被迫收慢避開他駒的後蹄，七百米處推進至中間之後位置。直路彎及二百五十米處失去平衡。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Mid division, switched wide for clear run 550m out, short-lived effort early in home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置。五百五十米處移出外疊以望空。直路初一度發力。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced prominently, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped well from gate 13, took the lead, led by a 1/2L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自最第十三檔出閘迅速，取得領先。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, dropped to midfield on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎墮居中間位置。直路初未能再增速，最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W2W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced better than midfield on the outside, moved a bit closer after passing 1100M, 2nd in the middle stages, outpaced early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走外疊。跑過千一米處後略為追近。中段居第二位。直路早段被拋離。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, 4-1/2L back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個半馬位。直路上未能以勁勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, three wide without cover, hung in final 200m, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 自最外檔出閘，墮後，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。最後二百米內閃。保持走勢，但未能加速以追上領先馬匹。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Worked through to sit just off the leader, pace very fast in the first half, asked for effort 300M but found nothing in a fading run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在催策下緊隨領放馬，賽事前半程步速甚快。三百米處受催策，但末段力竭，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Bumped heavily at start, raced in midfield on the outside, 4 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 起步時發生大力碰撞，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, same position on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, disputed led, clear leader top of home straight, headed by winner 250m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，爭奪領先。直路初領放。二百五十米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Three wide in mid-field, pushed along widest into home straight, outpaced and left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped at the start, from draw 11 moved up to track leader, all out final 400M but was readily held by the winner who was 4 runs unbeaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第十一檔起步時發生碰撞，上前跟隨領放馬。最後四百米全力以赴，但一直落後四戰全勝的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W1W) Pressed forward from a poor draw settling 1L back 3-wide in back straight, kept on from a similar position into home straight before dropping out tamely 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W1W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前。對面直路上落後一個馬位，走第三疊。入直路時自相若位置保持走勢。一百米處乏力墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Crowded and heavily bumped out of stalls, raced in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時受擠迫，發生大力碰撞，居後列。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began fairly, ended up racing in last over 8Ls off the pace, had big task in hand turning home, made some progress in the straight without posing threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘一般，居包尾位置，落後領放馬逾八個馬位。轉入直路時落後甚遠。直路上略為追前，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced at tail, 7 lengths or so back turning in, hard ridden from 300M but only showed limited response, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居包尾位置。入直路時落後約七個馬位。自三百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began awkwardly, raced behind midfield, 6 lengths back turning in, made little progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly, raced behind midfield on the inside, angled out 500M, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走內疊。五百米處向外移出。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W5W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 550M, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W5W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處向外移出。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped only fairly, settled towards rear, ran on smoothly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。末段走勢暢順，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Settled in the last few 3 wide, niggled along to improve out wide 600M out, carried wider rounding for home, faded over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 居最後數位之內，走第三疊。六百米處受催策以推進，走外疊。轉直路彎時被帶出更外疊。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, wider on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速， 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎走更外疊。直路初對催策略有反應，一百五十米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Never far off, baulked briefly behind runners early in home straight, could only keep on steadily without quickening in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 從未遠離領先馬匹。直路初一度在馬群之後受困。末段僅能保持穩勢，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, soon headed by winner 150m out, stayed on well for a clear third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初加速，二百米處取得領先，瞬即在一百五十米處被頭馬超越。保持佳勢，帶離餘駒，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Waited with towards rear, keen early, pushed along wide into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。早段搶口。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Soon taken well behind from a poor draw trailing the field to straight, did not find much room on rail behind runners early in straight, running on when baulked again closing stages. (Tactic questioned)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自第十一檔出閘後瞬即留居包尾位置。尾隨馬群至直路前。直路早段走內欄，但在馬群之後空位不足。末段上前時再度受困。（騎師被查詢競跑策略。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, moved a bit closer after passing 600M, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。跑過六百米處後略為追近。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。末段衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W3W3W) Out in line, raced towards rear on the inside, 2 wide from 800M, 3 wide after passing 650M, very wide into straight, finished off very strongly to score by a head.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居後列，走內疊。自八百米處起走第二疊。跑過六百五十米處後走第三疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段衝刺凌厲，以馬頭位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, driven along 600m out, switched for clear run 200m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處受催策。二百米處轉換跑線以望空，末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Sat near the rear 2 wide, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Away on fairly and settled worse than midfield, closed off ok to finish a distant 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。末段衝刺不俗，取得第五名，但所負頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, held up last, short of room 300m out to 200m out, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，留居包尾位置。三百米處至二百米處之間空位不足。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Waited with in rear, pushed along 400m out, left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處受推策。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, shuffled back after halfway, angled wide over 200m out, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。半程後墮後。二百米處移出外疊。保持走勢，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Settled rear, traveled okay, made steady ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，走勢不俗。末段以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W2W3W) Waited with, under pressure in rear turning into home straight, strong run on wide outside final 150m, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W2W3W) 留力候上。轉入直路時居後列，受催策。最後一百五十米在外疊走勢強勁。接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W3W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, under pressure from the 450M, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W3W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。自四百五十米處起受催策。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, made minor ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure 500m out to chase leaders, ran on well final 200m to close on winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居中間位置。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米以佳勢上前，追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, a bit closer on turn, no clear run early in straight, made some progress after passing 300M, blocked again final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎略為追近。直路早段未能望空。跑過三百米處後略為追前。一百五十米處再度受阻。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled worse than midfield 2 wide, ran on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Settled behind midfield on the rail; had difficulty securing clear running in the straight but kept on well once clear (see Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路上難以望空，但望空後隨即保持佳勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in rear of midfield on rail, drifted further off the pace when tempo increased around home bend, didn't find much room behind runners early in straight until 150M when hung in and difficult to ride, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。轉直路彎時在步速加快之際落後領放馬更遠。直路初在馬群之後空位不足，直至一百五十米處內閃，難以被策騎。其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat last, never in contention. (Unacceptable Performance, must trial)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。（表現難以接受。必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Slowly away, held up, left behind home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，留後。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (4W3W2W2W) Settled in front of midfield, strode forward in the middle stages and crossed the lead, ran on evenly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(4W3W2W2W) 居中間之前位置。中段展步上前，超越領放馬。末段走勢平穩。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W2W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced prominently, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘普通，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on strongly to score. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持強勁走勢，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) In rear after impeded leaving stalls, dropped to last place 500m out, ran on strongly final 200m to pass plenty of field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘時受阻礙，其後居後列。五百米處墮居包尾位置。最後二百米以勁勢追前，超越多駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Sent forward to be prominent 3 wide, kept on only fairly. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 受催策上前，居前列，走第三疊。末段僅能保持一般走勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Jumped well from gate 12, raced prominently on the outside, slightly taken back after passing 1200M, positioned 2 wide, 2 lengths back in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。跑過千二米處後稍為留後，走第二疊。中段落後兩個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W5W) Jumped awkwardly and then checked briefly, in rear, very wide and pushed along turning into home straight, no response.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W5W) 出閘笨拙，其後一度勒避，居後列，走大外疊。轉入直路時受推策，毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W4W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段超越部分已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Fast break, outpaced and raced in rear, dropped to last place 700m out, pushed along 650m out, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，其後未能跟上步速，居後列。七百米處墮居包尾位置。六百五十米處受推策。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Waited with towards rear, still in rear top of home straight, blocked off when going for run 250m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。二百五十米處在嘗試取位時受困。未能收復失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last pair turning into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。轉入直路時仍居最後兩位之內。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, good headway final bend, sustained headway to make run 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎追前甚多。持續上前，二百米處展開衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Niggled at early, soon obtained rails run in midfield in 7th, remained in a similar position into straight hugging the rail, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 早段受催策，瞬即佔取中間第七位，走內欄。入直路時保持相若位置，固守內欄。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Taken back from gate 11, raced at rear on the outside, bumped near 700M, 7 lengths back turning in, showed limited response in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自第十一檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。接近七百米處時被碰撞。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上對催策反應平平。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat rear, raced keenly in the middle stages, held up making the Home Turn, could not be fully tested when positioned close to heels.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。中段搶口。轉直路彎時受困。末段在靠近一駒後蹄時未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Wide throughout in mid-field, one paced under pressure, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，沿途走外疊。在催策下保持同速，未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat towards the rear on the rail, made no ground
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Waited with, clear run up rail and good headway from top of home straight, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 留力候上。自直路初起沿欄望空，追前甚多。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled midfield, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stayed on steadily but no threat to front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。保持穩勢，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W4W) Mid-field, wide into home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置。入直路時走外疊。保持走勢，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (4W2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, commenced move out wide from 600m out, widest into home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(4W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。自六百米處起開始發力，走外疊。入直路時走最外疊。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out approaching 350M, closed off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。趨近三百五十米處時向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Settled in midfield, came under pressure onto home bend, one of the widest into straight, ran on to assert authority close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。開始轉直路彎時受催策。入直路時為走最外疊的馬匹之一。追前，接近終點時控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Began moderately settling towards rear, kept on one pace without quickening from a similar position into home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘普通，居後列。入直路時保持同速，未能自相若位置加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Started well from wide draw but soon taken back to race in rear, stayed on well down the outside final 200m and passed several rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，但瞬即留居後列。最後二百米保持佳勢，走外疊，超越數匹對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。保持走勢，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, good headway final bend, sustained headway to challenge 200m out, strong run to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎追前甚多。持續推進，二百米處展開挑戰。衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W3W) Mid-field, sustained run from 300m out, led final 100m, won decisively.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W3W) 居中間位置。自三百米處起持續追前。一百米處取得領先，以出色姿態勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Bumped and lost balance shortly after leaving stalls, raced in rear, chased along final bend, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘後不久被碰撞，失去平衡，居後列。直路彎追趕對手。最後二百米走勢強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced prominently, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Sat on pace 3 wide, raced without cover throughout, gave ground quickly in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 跟前競跑，走第三疊，沿途沒有遮擋。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began only fairly from gate 1, raced behind midfield on the inside, unbalanced near 600M, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。接近六百米處時失去平衡。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, rear of mid-field, didn't travel with much fluency on bend, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。直路彎走勢欠順。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Sat midfield on the rail, ran on nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。以佳勢上前，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Out with rest, raced 3 wide in midfield, no cover for the majority of the race, very wide turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第三疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Sat midfield 3 wide, angled out in the Straight, just one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路上向外移出。在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Chased leader, under pressure 550m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 追趕領放馬。五百五十米處受催策。保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run until final 50M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至最後五十米。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) A little awkward away and threw the head about, over-raced in the early and middle stages, momentarily held up at the top of home straight, ran on fairly well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘略為笨拙，將頭兩邊擺動。早段及中段搶口。直路初一度受困。末段在催策下走勢不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (2W3W) Jumped fast, led early stages before taking up a trailing position behind leaders, worked into the race nicely passing 400M, fought hard to the line but was held by winner throughout the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘迅速，早段領先，其後在領先馬匹之後取得遮擋。跑過四百米處時以佳勢上前。力拼至終點，但末段沿途未能追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Jumped well from gate 13, tracked leaders on the outside, no cover throughout, showed good response in straight, took the lead 200M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自第十三檔出閘迅速，跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路上對催策反應良佳，二百米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但最後一百米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (1W1W) Ridden early to be up with the pace, gradually shifted over 2L back in 5th home bend, angled off rail for a run on straightening but no clear run until about 200M out, quickened well late to snatch 2nd close to finish.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策以緊隨領放馬。直路彎逐漸墮居第五位，落後逾兩個馬位。入直路時移離內欄取位，但未能望空直至約二百米處。末段加速良佳。接近終點時跑獲亞軍。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W2W2W) Sat outside the leader, just one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。末段僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sluggish start, three wide in mid-field without cover, pushed along 600m out to chase leaders, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped awkwardly, recovered to race mid-field, driven 400m out, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘笨拙。恢復走勢，居中間位置。四百米處受催策，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat towards rear, limited response when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。對催策反應平平。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, stayed on well down the outside from over 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。自二百米處起在外疊以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Mid-field, raced wide, stayed on final 200m to snatch fourth late, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。最後二百米保持走勢。末段進佔第四位，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, raced at rear on the outside, 7 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Gradually taken back after beginning from a poor draw settling in last few, 3-wide rounding home bend, ran past well-beaten horses closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘後逐漸留居最後數位之內。轉直路彎時走第三疊。末段超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled handy on the rail, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。走勢尚可。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Waited with in rear, pushed along 400m out, some headway final 200m, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處受推策。最後二百米略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Mid-field, short of room when trying to improve between horses from 300m out, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。自三百米處起在馬匹之間嘗試推進時空位不足，未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Mid-field, struggling to go pace from halfway, dropped away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置。自半程起難以跟上步速。墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Settled slightly worse than midfield, unable to slot in somewhere from gate 11, drifted backwards and lost position 400M out, failed to run on when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 自第十一檔出閘後未能切入，居中間稍後位置。四百米處墮後，失位。在催策下未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W) Sat at the rear, weakened and gave ground quickly in the Straight. (See Incident Report) (Unacceptable Performance, must trial)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W) 居後列。直路上迅速轉弱及墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）（表現難以接受。必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made very good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，接近終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W3W) Out with rest, raced prominently, 2 wide, allowed rival to cross near 800M, peaked on turn, weakened early in straight, eased final 100M.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居前列，走第二疊。接近八百米處時讓對手過頭。直路彎未能再加速。直路早段轉弱。最後一百米收慢。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, lost position after passing 750M, positioned 4 wide, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened and eased final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。跑過七百五十米處後失位。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位，走第四疊。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Mid-division, drifted left under pressure from 300m out, stayed on but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。自三百米處起在催策下向外斜跑。保持走勢，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Mid-field, pushed along over 300m out, no impression, including after switched off rail 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置。三百米處受推策。一百米處移離內欄後毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Crowded on jumping, raced in 2nd, a length or so back, peaked 300M, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;躍出時受擠迫，居第二位，落後約一個馬位。三百米處未能再增速。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Moderately away from a wide draw, raced 3 wide, 4 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，落後約四個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎落後相同距離。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Began awkwardly and lost ground, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader, hard ridden after passing 300M but only showed limited response, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;出閘笨拙及失地，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位。跑過三百米處後受力策，但反應僅屬平平。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Soon taken back for rails run, steadily pulled his way forward to just worse than midfield in 10th onto home bend, saved ground turning in for 7th, kept on at the one pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 瞬即留後，走內欄。穩步上前，開始轉直路彎時居中間稍後第十位。入直路時走內欄節省腳程，居第七位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Sat midfield on the rail, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders, switched to challenge leaders 500m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處轉換跑線以挑戰領先馬匹。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Taken back to race 3 wide towards rear, 6 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 留居後列，落後約六個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (4W2W2W) Mid division, pushed along wide into home straight, tended to shift right in home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(4W2W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路上傾向向內斜跑。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Tracked pace three wide, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leader, weakened 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。三百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in rear of mid-field, briefly hampered 800m out, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。八百米處一度受阻礙。直路初受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Led early, headed after 500m, remained prominent, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 早段領放。跑了五百米後被超越。保持居前列。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Raced 3-wide in midfield, struggled to keep up 600M, soon beaten turning home. (Jockey - may not have appreciated racing on AWT / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。六百米處難以跟上對手。轉直路彎時瞬即洩氣。（騎師表示，坐騎或未能適應在全天候跑道上作賽。賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: (3W4W3W) Sat midfield, raced wide throughout, weakened late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: (3W4W3W) 居中間位置，沿途走外疊，末段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W) Waited with in rear from high draw, stayed on down the outside final 150m, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後居後列，留力候上。最後一百五十米沿外疊保持走勢，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in rear top of home straight, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W3W) Sat at the rear on the rail, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W3W) 居後列，走內欄。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled on the rail just off the speed, threw his head about in the middle stages, lacked a finish effort over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居領放馬稍後位置，走內欄。中段搶口。末段衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W) Settled midfield, held up at the Turn, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間位置。直路彎受困。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide better than midfield, angled out 350M, kept on well in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。三百五十米處向外移出。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began only fairly from gate 1, raced towards rear on the inside, angled out 400M, taken wide in straight and made good progress without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。四百米處向外移出。直路上移出外疊，追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W2W) Sat midfield 3 wide early, got into 2 wide spot rounding the Home Turn, short of room top of the Straight, closed off reasonably well despite the inference.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W2W) 早段居中間位置，走第三疊。轉直路彎時移入第二疊。直路初空位不足。儘管受干擾，但末段衝刺頗佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Mid-field, angled off rail and chased leaders into home straight, responded to pressure to lead closing stages, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時移離內欄，追趕領先馬匹。末段對催策交出反應，取得領先。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Settled in mid-field, travelled smoothly to 500m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置。五百米處前走勢暢順。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Away with them, raced 3 wide in midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, finished off well to take 2nd, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Mid-field, raced on outside of field, no impression under pressure, dropped away final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置，走外欄。在催策下毫無表現。最後一百五十米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began well from gate 10, raced in midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, finished off strongly to take a place, nearest finish. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺強勁，跑獲季軍。過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Close up early, gradually taken over 2L back in 5th and 3-wide without cover rounding home bend, weakened under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 早段緊隨領放馬。轉直路彎時逐漸留居第五位，落後逾兩個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段在催策下轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped at the start, dropped back to race towards the rear 5Ls off the pace, made some inroads towards the finish but failed to seriously threaten at any stage.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時發生碰撞，墮居後列，落後領放馬五個馬位。末段略為追前，但從未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Waited with towards rear, struggled to hold position from 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。自四百米處起難以保持位置。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Maintained a position in midfield, came under pressure home turn and dropped away on straightening. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。直路彎受催策。入直路時墮退。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat behind the leaders on the rail, kept on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (6W3W3W) Began well from gate 10, trapped very wide in midfield early, moved a bit closer after passing 850M, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(6W3W3W) 自第十檔出閘迅速。早段居中間位置，走大外疊。跑過八百五十米處後略為追近。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sent forward to race prominently, 2 wide, 1/2L back turning in, hit the front approaching 200M, kept on well to hold off the challengers late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 受催策上前，居前列，走第二疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。趨近二百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，力拒對手挑戰掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Ridden along in the early stages to be one out one back, stuck on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 早段受催策，居第二疊第二位。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Disputed lead between horses, nothing extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在馬匹之間爭奪領先。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Began smartly, raced prominently, 2 wide, took the lead 950M, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually final 50M, finished 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。九百五十米處取得領先，入直路時領先四分三個馬位。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後五十米逐漸轉弱，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, kept on to hold 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走勢尚可。保持走勢，保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Average to begin, raced better than midfield, nearer to the middle track, kept on well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘普通。居中間之前位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。保持佳勢，跑入季席，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the outside, 2 wide on turn, made some progress early in straight, no clear run final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路彎走第二疊。直路早段略為追前。最後二百米未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Bounced away awkwardly and checked when bumped, made some headway from the tail of the field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，在被碰撞之際勒避。末段自馬群尾列略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Travelled very wide without cover in rear of midfield, yielded ground rounding home bend, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間之後位置，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎時墮退。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Prominent, took up running over 800M out setting a sound pace, held narrow lead until headed about 250M out, folded up quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，八百米處帶頭，以快步速領放。以短距離領先，直至二百五十米處被超越。迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, towards the rear 6Ls back, failed to run on in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列，落後六個馬位。直路上未能上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon recovered from moderate start along the rail to share early pace, crossed by race leaders and lost position 600M out, some 3L back in 4th rounding home bend, faded steadily in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步普通，瞬即恢復走勢，早段跟上步速，走內欄。六百米處被領先馬匹橫越，失位。轉直路彎時居第四位，落後約三個馬位。直路上逐漸力竭。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Heroic Valour from Magazine Miss, a daughter of Publishing. Horses by the same sires include Gallant Valour and Etalon Or. The fellow was given seven trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished fourth under the whip, beaten by 2-1/4Ls, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on October 12. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: Heroic Valour之後，在港同父馬包括「耀寶駒」及「準輝煌」等駒，生母出自Publishing。抵港後試閘七次。最近10月12日出試從化草地1000米，早段居中，末段鞭策下跑第四名，落後頭馬2.25個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Derryn from Magic Tryst, a daughter of Magic Ring. Horses by the same sire include Flash Current and Aestheticism. He was given one trial for one placing in Hong Kong. In the trial, he sat midfield and finished second under pressure, beaten by 2Ls, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on October 12. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「維省議員」(Derryn)之後，在港同父馬包括「閃光燈」及「唯美主義」等駒，生母出自Magic Ring。抵港後一次試閘一次即上名。最近10月12日出試從化草地1000米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬兩個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced better than midfield on the inside, easy run to turn, finished off well to take 2nd, just beaten by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎前走勢輕鬆。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，僅以一馬頸位見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Recovered from sluggish start to race in mid-field against rail, some headway 300m out, soon unable to sustain, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步緩慢，恢復走勢，居中間位置，走內欄。三百米處略為追前，瞬即無以為繼 。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover off pace, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居領放馬之後，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Sat outside lead, kept on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速，最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced 3 wide better than midfield, 2 wide approaching 600M, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。趨近六百米處時走第二疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Took up running over 1000M out setting a sound pace and led until weakened over 350M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 一千米處取得領先，以快步速領放。保持領先，直至三百五十米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well in the middle stages, headed near 450M, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，受催策上前領放。中段走勢良佳。接近四百五十米處時被超越。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Chased leader, weakened over 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;追趕領放馬。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Made contact shortly after start, raced better than midfield, 2 away from the stands' rail, dropped to midfield in the middle stages, hard ridden after passing 400M but showed no response, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走外欄第三疊。中段墮居中間位置。跑過四百米處後受力策，但毫無反應。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leading pair, clear run up inside rail early in straight and challenged over 200m out, soon no extra, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先兩駒。直路初沿欄望空。二百米處受挑戰。瞬即再無餘力，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) In touch with leaders, headway to challenge 200m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。二百米處上前展開挑戰，最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced 3 wide in midfield early, 2 wide from 500M, unable to obtain clear run until final 100M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 起步時向內斜跑，被碰撞。早段居中間位置，走第三疊。自五百米處起走第二疊。未能望空直至最後一百米。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Began well from gate 9, sent forward to race prominently, 3/4L back turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd, no threat to the winner. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列。入直路時落後四分三馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。未能威脅頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled smoothly, could not be fully tested when held up over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走勢順暢。末段受困時未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, unable to quicken in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。直路上未能加速。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Began smartly from gate 1, raced in 2nd, 1-1/2L back turning in, showed very good response in straight, took the lead approaching 100M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居第二位。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上對催策反應甚佳。趨近一百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Made contact at start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, stayed on evenly to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 起步時被觸碰，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, headed top of home straight, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初被超越。末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well from the widest draw, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, stayed on evenly to take a place.
