runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速及被超越。保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Jumped well from a wide draw, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一又四分一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Shifted out at start and bumped, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Jumped well from the widest draw, sent forward to take the lead but trapped 4 wide, shared lead with rivals turning in, peaked and headed early in straight, weakened inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 自最外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放，但走第四疊。入直路時與對手並排領先。直路早段未能再加速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Led from pole position, headed final 100M, unable to find an extra gear when being challenged.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自最內檔出閘後領放。最後一百米被超越。受挑戰時未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W) Raced 3 wide no cover, kept on only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W) 走第三疊，沒有遮擋。僅能保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Mid-field, checked briefly halfway and unable to hold position, left behind in rear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。半程時一度勒避，未能保持位置。最後二百米被拋離，居後列過終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderate start, recovered swiftly between runners to take up running over 950M out setting a smart pace on home bend, led until tiring 300M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，其後在馬匹之間迅速恢復走勢，九百五十米處取得領先。直路彎以快步速領放。保持領先直至三百米處呈現疲態。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped on terms and settled 3rd towards the middle part of the track, responded only fairly when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;與對手同步躍出，居第三位，在跑道中央競跑。對催策反應僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Average to begin, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L at 400M, peaked and headed 150M, ran on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，受催策上前領先。四百米處領先四分三個馬位。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat rear, shifted in and obtained clear running near 400M, responded nicely when asked inside 200M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居後列。接近四百米處時向內移入，望空。二百米處對催策反應良佳。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) From draw 1 obtained a midfield position along the inside, ran on steadily on straightening to finish 4th but was always held by leaders over final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，居中間位置，走內疊。入直路時穩步上前，取得第四名，但最後二百米一直落後領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Pressed forward to be racing just off the leader, ran on well under pressure from 400M, briefly led inside 200M but not finishing as well as the first two late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;受催策上前跟隨領放馬。自四百米處起受催策以佳勢上前，最後二百米一度領先，但末段衝刺不及前兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled within striking distance in 3rd on rail, tight for a run early in straight, gained upper hand 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居第三位，落後領放馬不遠，走內欄。直路早段緊迫競跑。一百米處佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, driven 300m out, headed by winner 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。三百米處受催策。二百米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Made contact at start, sent forward to race prominently, travelled well to turn, took the lead 300M, peaked and headed 200M, weakened final 100M.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時與對手互相觸碰，受催策上前，居前列。直路彎前走勢良佳。三百米處取得領先。二百米處未能再增速及被超越。最後一百米轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to press leader, challenged leader early in home straight, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策，追迫領放馬。直路初挑戰領放馬。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W3W) Broke well from a poor draw before taken back to 5th over 4L back, further away when pace quickened around home bend, hung in inconvenienced rider over 200M out but ran on well inside final 200M, just failed to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，其後留居第五位，落後逾四個馬位。轉直路彎賽事步速加快時落後更遠。二百米處內閃以致騎師受妨礙，但最後二百米走勢良佳。終點線上僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W1W2W) Bumped out of stalls, across to press leader, struggled to hold position from 600m out, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W1W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，切入以追迫領放馬。自六百米處起難以保持位置。所負甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, unable to hold position early stages, angled out 500m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。早段未能保持位置。五百米處向外移出。末段保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Stumbled leaving stalls and bumped shortly after start, in rear, switched wide for clear run top of home straight, ran on well to move into second close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時失蹄，其後不久與對手互相碰撞，居後列。直路初移出外疊以望空。以佳勢追前，接近終點時進佔第二位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, settled down behind leaders along the fence, came through strongly to challenge for the lead 250M, all out final stages to beat off the persistent runner up.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。以勁勢上前，二百五十米處爭奪領先。末段全力拼鬥，擊敗緊追不捨的亞軍馬匹掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) From draw 1 went forward to track leader along the fence, fought well in the straight, tried had final 200M but was always held by the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，上前跟隨領放馬，走內欄。直路上以佳勢力拼。最後二百米力拼，但一直落後頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Stayed close to leaders towards outside of the field, couldn't sustain run final 200M and faded closing stages. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;保持緊隨領先馬匹，在馬群外側競跑。最後二百米後繼無力，末段力竭。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Away fast, restrained to race in midfield, brought wide in the straight and closed off strongly to lead close home. (Trainer - advantaged by racing over HV 1000M where it had performed well.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，受約束，居中間位置。直路上移至外疊。衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先。（練馬師表示，此駒今仗角逐以往表現良佳的跑馬地一千米賽事，有利發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) From draw 1 went forward tracking leader, couldn't keep passing 300M, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，上前跟隨領放馬。跑過三百米處時未能跟上，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Driven to the lead setting even pace up front, headed by pursuing rivals nearing 200M, weakened badly final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策以取得領先，以平穩步速帶頭。接近二百米處時被緊追的對手超越。末段嚴重轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Stumbled leaving stalls, recovered to track leading pair, weakened over 300m out, left behind.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘時失蹄，恢復走勢後跟隨領先兩駒。最後三百米轉弱。末段被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Bumped at the start, moved up to race behind the runaway leader, battled to hold 2nd early straight, no extra final 150M losing several places in closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，上前，居遙遙領先的領放馬之後。直路初力拼以保住第二位。最後一百五十米再無餘力。末段失去數位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped on terms, stayed close to leader but couldn't quicken passing 400M, weakened away mid-straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;與對手同步躍出。緊隨領放馬，但跑過四百米處時未能增速。直路中段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) Made contact at start, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the stands' side, no clear run until 250M, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)起步時發生觸碰，落後領放馬三個馬位，靠近外欄競跑。未能望空直至二百五十米處。衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled in rear of midfield on the rail, drifted slightly worse approaching home bend, ran on from 8th into straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。趨近直路彎時略為墮後。入直路時自第八位追前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Taken well back early from a wide barrier, ridden forward to reach 9th towards rear inside the 700M remaining 3-wide without cover to straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘，早段遙居於後。受催策上前，七百米處進佔後列的第九位。直路前仍走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped in line, dropped back to sit behind mid-division, brought widest for his challenge in the straight, closed off well to go 2nd near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，墮居中間之後位置。直路上移至最外疊展開挑戰。衝刺良佳，接近終點時跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped fairly settling over 2L back in 6th on rail, drifted further off the pace rounding home bend switching off the rail for a run, ran on steadily inside final 150M without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，居第六位，落後逾兩個馬位，走內欄。轉直路彎時落後領放馬更遠，移離內欄取位。最後一百五十米穩步上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back to race 2 wide slightly behind midfield early, found rail near 600M, 4 lengths back on turn, closed off well to take 2nd on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段留居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。接近六百米處時移入內欄。直路彎落後四個馬位。衝刺良佳，過終點時跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Waited with towards rear, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初受催策，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) In rear after sluggish start, unable to hold position from 500m out, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。自五百米處起未能保持位置。洩氣潰敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, raced in touch with leaders against rail, good headway middle stages, strong run to lead 150m out, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與他駒互相碰撞。緊隨領先馬匹，走內欄。中段追前甚多。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先，輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W2W2W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 100M, kept on very well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上對催策反應甚佳。一百米處取得領先。末段保持甚佳走勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, ran on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) Settled in rear of mid-field, switched towards centre of course for clear run 300m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)居中間之後位置。三百米處移向跑道中央以望空。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) Sat 2 off the outside rail midfield, took some time to respond, stayed on late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)居中間位置，走外欄第三疊。需時對催策作出反應。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Angled across to track leaders, stuck on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;向外移出以跟隨領先馬匹。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, forced to steady 450m out, well held from 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。四百五十米處被迫收慢。自二百米處起遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Jumped only fairly, not hurried and settled towards the rear 6Ls back, brought wide 300M but responded only fairly. Never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，未受催策，居後列，落後六個馬位。三百米處移出外疊，但對催策反應僅屬一般。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped only fairly, ended up as the back marker from 600M, couldn't keep up 400M, soon beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘僅屬一般。自六百米處起居包尾位置，四百米處未能跟上對手，瞬即洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled just worse than midfield, found no extra upon straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間稍後位置。入直路後再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Crowded at start, settled just worse than midfield, saved ground on the inside turning for home, ran on steadily to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間稍後位置。轉直路彎時走內疊節省腳程。穩步上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from draw 1, restrained to a midfield spot, raced keenly in the middle stages, kept on well enough in the straight but not going the pace of first two final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受約束，居中間位置。中段搶口。直路上保持佳勢，但最後二百米加速力不及頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, reserved behind midfield in a fast run race, finished off fairly well final 300M but not going the pace of first two closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居中間之後位置，賽事步速偏快。最後三百米衝刺不俗，但末段加速力不及頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (4W1W2W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier to 2nd chasing leader on rail in back straight, fanned wide for a run turning for home and hit the front 200M out only to be overhauled inside final 60M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(4W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前。對面直路上居第二位，沿欄追趕領放馬。轉入直路時向外移出以望空。二百米處取得領先。僅在最後六十米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced in midfield, left flat footed when the race got serious from 400M. Never threatened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置。自四百米處起馬群加速時停滯不前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W) Raced 3-wide without cover just better than midfield, weakened out of contention inside final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W) 居中間稍前位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。最後二百五十米轉弱，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced behind midfield, 5 lengths or so back, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，落後約五個馬位。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled at the rear on the rail, 2 wide in the turn, made good ground from the back in last 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居包尾位置，走內欄。直路彎走第二疊。最後一百五十米自後列追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (6W3W3W) From wide draw obtained a midfield position along the 3-path, ran on mildly over final 300M for 3rd. Not reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(6W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後居中間位置，走第三疊。最後三百米走勢普通，跑入季席。未能追上頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; In 5th on settling, came under pressure 500M, soon out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居第五位。五百米處受催策。其後瞬即再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Badly crowded at start losing ground and dropping to the rear, similar into home straight, ran on strongly down the centre of the track to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時嚴重受擠迫，失地，墮居後列。入直路時位置相若。直路上在跑道中央以勁勢追前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped on terms, soon race in a forward spot just off the pace, driven to lead inside 250M, fought on late to hold off runner up in a close finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;與對手同步躍出，瞬即居前列，緊隨領放馬。二百五十米處在催策下領先。末段力拼，在短兵相接下力拒亞軍馬匹取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, under pressure throughout, lacked pace to challenge up rail in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。沿途受催策。直路上走內欄，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W3W) Dropped back form wide draw to race in a position near last, wide into straight but couldn't quite finish off in the straight. (Jockey : disadvantaged by settling back in the field.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘，墮居接近包尾位置。入直路時走外疊。直路上未能以勁勢衝刺。（騎師表示，坐騎居後列，不利發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, raced keenly, raced very wide throughout, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。搶口。沿途走大外疊。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Average to begin, urged along early stages to stay in touch with the field 4 back the fence, dashed home when winner was off and gone.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，早段受催策以跟上馬群，落後四個馬位，走內欄。末段發力衝刺，但頭馬已加速帶離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped fairly settling in midfield on rail, soon came to challenge under pressure upon straightening, gained upper hand 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走內欄。入直路後瞬即在催策下展開挑戰。五十米處佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; Went forward tracking the pace on the stand's side, kept up with leaders from 400M, raced tight along the fence and had difficulty obtaining clear running between 150M-50M. Held by leaders final stages.
(Sustained an abrasion to the right front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained an abrasion to the right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;沿外欄上前跟隨領放馬。自四百米處起持續追趕領先馬匹。沿外欄緊迫競跑，一百五十米處至五十米處之間難以望空，末段未能追上領先馬匹。
（右前腿擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, no clear run early in straight, made minor progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路早段未能望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, mid division, shifted right in home straight, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘時被碰撞，居中間位置。直路上向內斜跑。未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Crowded at start, wide in midfield early stages, gained 4th within 3L of pace 600M out, ran on under pressure in straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫。早段居中間位置，走外疊。六百米處進佔第四位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。直路上在催策下追前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sat just behind the speed 2 off the stands' rail, closed off nicely, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居領放馬稍後位置，走外欄第三疊。末段衝刺良佳，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) Sat towards the rear center track, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)居後列，在跑道中央競跑。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped awkwardly from a wide barrier bumping others, travelled wide in rear of midfield most of the way, ran home at the one pace inside final 200M.
(Lost right front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘笨拙，碰撞他駒。大部分途程居中間之後位置，走外疊。最後二百米以均速衝刺。
（失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Broke well from a middle barrier, travelled in 2nd 3-wide without cover before gaining 2-wide position onto home bend, held every chance in straight until outsprinted by the winner inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第七檔出閘迅速，居第二位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。開始轉直路彎時移入第二疊。直路上一度甚具爭勝機會，最後一百五十米被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) From draw 1 sat handily behind leaders, moved up to challenge for the lead early straight, led inside 200M and had every chance, caught by first two late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，跟隨領先馬匹。直路初上前爭奪領先。二百米處取得領先，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段被首兩名馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Not far off early, improved to one-out-one-back 600M out, hit the front over 250M out only to find no extra inside final 100M
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 早段落後不遠。六百米處推進至第二位，走第二疊。二百五十米處取得領先，僅於最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced very wide with the leaders holding narrow advantage between the 800 and 600M, close-up in 2nd on rail turning into straight, unable to draw level throughout and swamped for 2nd final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與領先馬匹並跑，走大外疊。八百米處至六百米處之間以短距離領先。轉入直路時沿欄追近，居第二位，但一直未能追上頭馬。最後數步被超越，失去亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Went forward, emerged as leader 850M, pressed by rival middle stages, hung on to the lead until passing 200M, weakened rapidly late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 上前，八百五十米處取得領先。中段受對手追迫。保持領先直至跑過二百米處。末段迅速轉弱。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W3W) Settled midfield 3 wide with cover, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Out with the line and sat 3-wide behind the leaders on settling, could not muster any sort of challenge in the straight and weakened passing 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居領先馬匹之後，走第三疊。直路上從未能展開挑戰。跑過三百米處時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide behind midfield, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Niggled along in forward of midfield on rail, steadied up in slackened tempo rounding home bend, baulked behind runners after straightening, quickened well inside final 150M to just get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 受催策，居中間之前位置，走內欄。轉直路彎步速減慢時收慢。入直路後在馬匹之後受困。最後一百五十米加速良佳。終點線上僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路初受催策，但速度不足以展開挑戰。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat towards the rear on the rail, made minor ground. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Made running, headed 400m out, weakening when checked 200m out, soon dropped away.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。四百米處被超越。二百米處在勒避之際轉弱。瞬即墮退。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Pressed leader, travelled smoothly to challenge leader top of home straight, ran on well to lead 200m out and hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。走勢暢順，直路初挑戰領放馬。走勢良佳，二百米處取得領先。保持走勢勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Began moderately racing wide behind midfield, keen early stages losing cover briefly at about 850M out, in last few into straight, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走外疊。早段搶口。約八百五十米處一度失去遮擋。入直路時居最後數位之內。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, ridden along to lead, kept on fairly well (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，在催策下取得領先。保持不俗走勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Fairly away, gradually settled in the last few, angled into the clear wide 450m out, lifted strongly to be 3/4 L outside the winner inside final 150m, unable to bridge the margin further.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘一般，逐漸居最後數位之內。四百五十米處移出外疊望空。衝刺強勁，一百五十米處居頭馬外側，落後四分三個馬位，但未能進一步收窄距離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W5W) Made contact with the right side of its starting gate on jumping, raced at rear, 9 lengths or so back, still 7 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W5W) 躍出時觸碰閘廂右側，居後列，落後約九個馬位。入直路時仍落後約七個馬位。直路上追前頗多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Slightly slow out, raced behind midfield on the inside, severely checked near 900M, positioned 2 wide towards rear on turn, showed no response early in straight, eased inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢，居中間之後位置，走內疊。接近九百米處時大力勒避。直路彎居後列，走第二疊。直路早段對催策毫無反應。最後二百米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W3W) Sat handy on the rail, showed good dash early part of the Straight, hit the front at the 200M, weakened final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W3W) 居前列，走內欄。直路早段以佳勢加速上前。二百米處取得領先。最後七十五米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (6W1W1W) Taken back to last from the widest barrier trailing the field to home straight, ran on past well-beaten ones inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(6W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。直路前尾隨馬群。最後一百米上前超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat behind midfield, lay in in the early Straight, gave ground inside 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路初內閃。一百五十米處墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Jumped only fairly, given a waiting ride towards the rear, brought wide into straight before running on moderately to the finish. Posed no threat to first three however.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，留力候上。入直路時移出外疊。保持不俗走勢至終點，但未能對頭三名馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Held up last after crowded leaving stalls, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘時受擠迫，其後留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for room turning into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Crowded start, taken back to race at tail, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，留居包尾位置。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路上追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Held up last, still in rear travelling smoothly 300m out, short of room when trying to improve 200m out, finished off strongly through horses, eye-catcher.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;留居包尾位置。三百米處仍居後列，走勢暢順。二百米處在嘗試推進之際空位不足。末段在馬匹之間衝刺強勁。表現悅目。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, ridden along 400m out, looked green but ran on well to lead 150m out and hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策。走勢稚嫩，但末段以佳勢上前，一百五十米處取得領先。保持領先至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Started well and tracked leader, led over 200m out, headed by winner 100m out, no extra and lost two places close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 出閘迅速，跟隨領放馬。二百米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越。接近終點時再無餘力，失去兩位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Travelled one back 3-wide without cover, came to join the leader rounding home bend, faded steadily inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 落後一個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎時追上領放馬。最後三百米逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Shared 5th about 3L off the pace on rail when checked and lost position 900M out, 4L back in 7th rounding home bend, no clear run early in straight and forced to check 300M out, produced some late impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 並居第五位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走內欄。九百米處勒避及失位。轉直路彎時居第七位，落後四個馬位。直路初未能望空。三百米處被迫勒避。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat in front of midfield, raced wide, gave ground quickly inside 150M (See Incident Report).
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊。一百五十米處迅速墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, weakened and gave ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路上轉弱及墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, sat towards rear, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。從未構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Slow to begin, raced at rear on the stands' rail, unable to obtain clear run final 400M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘緩慢，居後列，走外欄。最後四百米未能望空。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced in touch, starting to struggle when tight for room 250m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;緊隨領先馬匹。二百五十米處受緊迫時開始掙扎上前。轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Raced in touch with leaders, tight for room and hampered 350m out, unable to secure clear run until 100m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;緊隨領先馬匹。三百五十米處受緊迫及受阻礙。其後未能望空直至一百米處。跑來欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Moderately away, raced in midfield on the stands' side, made no progress final 400M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，居中間位置，靠近外欄競跑。最後四百米毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced close up against rail, pushed along 300m out, no extra final 150m.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。三百米處受推策。最後一百五十米再無餘力。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持走勢，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Always thereabouts settling one back on rail behind leader cum eventual winner over 800M out, fought on under pressure but unable to quicken to threaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 沿途居啣接位置。八百米處落後領放馬兼頭馬一個馬位，走內欄。在催策下力拼，但未能加速以構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, ridden along to lead, traveled comfortably, led all the way to score (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速。受催策，取得領先，走勢暢順。一放到底，取得勝利。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Began well, raced behind midfield on the stands' side, 3 to 4 lengths back in the middle stages, passed some tired runners final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，靠近外欄競跑。中段落後三至四個馬位。最後四百米超越部分已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened from the 300M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。自三百米處起轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Recovered quickly from moderate start to lead after the first 100M setting a sound pace, ceded advantage for 2nd spot onto home bend, remained prominent in 3rd into straight but folded up quickly inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘普通，迅速恢復走勢，過了首一百米後取得領先，以快步速領放。開始轉直路彎時被超越，居第二位。入直路時居前列第三位，但最後二百米迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, in control final 100m, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。最後一百米控制大局。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, stayed on well, pressed by runner-up to line and just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路初加速，取得領先，保持佳勢。被亞軍馬匹追迫至終點，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, under pressure to hold position 500m out, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策以保持位置。從未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Made contact at start, raced behind midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之後位置。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Out in line, raced 2 wide in midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W4W) Amongst leaders early drifting backward to midfield onto home bend, steadied for a stride 700M out, switched wide for a run entering straight, ran on well to just fail to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W4W) 早段居領先馬群中。開始轉直路彎時墮居中間位置。七百米處一度收慢。入直路時移出外疊以取位。以佳勢追前，終點線上僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Made contact at start, taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, wider turning in, made good progress early in straight, peaked 100M, kept on same pace to the line.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路初追前甚多。一百米處未能再增速。保持同速至終點。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover midfield, ran on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Bumped out of stalls, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米走勢強勁，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W3W4W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide in midfield, hard ridden after passing 450M, wide into straight, kept on same pace in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W3W4W) 起步時被碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過四百五十米處後受力策。入直路時走外疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, held up at the early Straight, no clear run until 150M, finished off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置。直路初受困，未能望空直至一百五十米處。衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, had to angle out for run 200m out, stayed on but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。二百米處須向外移出取位。保持走勢，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Soon taken back to last few from a wide barrier, went wide onto home bend and the widest into straight, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即留居最後數位之內。開始轉直路彎時走外疊。入直路時走最外疊。其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide towards rear, 3 wide after passing 700M, 5 to 6 lengths back on turn, very wide into straight, finished off very strongly to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，走第二疊。跑過七百米處後走第三疊。直路彎落後五至六個馬位。入直路時走大外疊。末段衝刺凌厲，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W5W) Settled in midfield mainly 3-wide with cover, commenced move on top of home bend swinging widest into straight, ran on under pressure inside final 200M to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W5W) 大多居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎早段開始上前，入直路時移出最外疊。最後二百米在催策下追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, stayed on strongly, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段保持強勁走勢，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W3W) Shortly after the start was tight for galloping room and was then ridden conservatively, responded well under reminders in the home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W3W) 起步後不久受緊迫，繼而留後。直路上對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Bumped out of stalls and crowded shortly after start, rail position in mid-field, effort 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時被碰撞，其後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處受催策。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W4W) Eased back after the start to race towards the rear, moved away from inside fence 500M, gave good initial response early straight but could not quicken enough over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W4W) 起步後收慢，留居後列。五百米處移離內欄。直路初起初對催策反應良佳，但末段加速力不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W5W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 650M, very wide turning in, made good progress early in straight, peaked on run 150M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W5W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，留居中間之後位置，走內疊。跑過六百五十米處後向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。直路早段追前甚多，一百五十米處未能再增速，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Sat towards the rear, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居後列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Waited with towards rear, still in rear top of home straight, left behind home straight.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。直路上被拋離。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Towards rear, short-lived headway 300m out, no real impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居後列。三百米處一度追前。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W5W) Trapped wide with no cover throughout from gate 11, commencing forward move from 700M, had tough run and unable to finish off (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W5W) 自第十一檔出閘。沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。自七百米處起開始上前。耗力太多，末段未能以勁勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Towards rear, good headway 300m out, no danger to winner but stayed on well to take second final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列。三百米處追前甚多。最後一百米保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W5W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, mid division, switched wide into home straight, ran on strongly to lead 200m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W5W) 出閘時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居中間位置。入直路時移出外疊。以勁勢上前，二百米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, checked 900m out, short of room early in home straight, forced to steady 200m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。九百米處勒避。直路早段空位不足。二百米處被迫收慢。未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W4W) Shifted out at start, raced behind midfield on the outside, a bit closer on turn, showed very good response in straight, took the lead approaching 150M, kept on very well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W4W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。直路上對催策反應甚佳。趨近一百五十米處時取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, tight for room between horses early in home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路早段在馬匹之間受緊迫。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced behind midfield, saved ground on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, hampered when switching out on the Home Turn, made some ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎向外移出時受阻礙，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Settled in last few, snuck closer though tight between runners early in home straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居最後數位之內。直路早段在對手之間緊迫競跑之際追近。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W4W) Four wide in mid-field without cover, raced very wide throughout, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W4W) 居中間位置，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。沿途走大外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。二百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W1W) Soon led and set well controlled pace to the straight, quickened up nicely passing 300M before keeping on well final stages to hold pursuing rivals at bay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W1W) 瞬即取得領先。直路前以穩定步速領放。跑過三百米處時加速良佳。末段保持佳勢，力拒緊追的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, headway up rail early stages, checked 700m out, never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。早段沿欄上前。七百米處勒避。從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W) Well there 3-wide, gained outright 2nd some1L back 900M out, lost position into straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W) 居好位，走第三疊。九百米處進佔第二位，落後約一個馬位。入直路時失位。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W) Soon in front setting steady pace, kept on well under pressure final 300M and gamely held on from pursuing rivals late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，以平穩步速領放。最後三百米在催策下保持佳勢。末段力拒緊追的對手掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Became unbalanced at the start, ended up 6Ls back towards the rear of the main group, made good progress in the straight finishing off final 200M fastest. (Jockey reprimanded for failing to ride out to the end of the race.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 起步時失去平衡，居主馬群後列，落後六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，最後二百米衝刺最快。（騎師因未有力策坐騎至終點而被譴責。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Outpaced early stages and settled in 2nd half of the field 5-6Ls off the pace, had the job ahead 400M, closed off mildly but was never a winning hope.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段未能跟上步速，居後半馬群，落後領放馬五至六個馬位。四百米處仍落後頗遠。衝刺普通，從未有望爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Held up in mid-pack along the inside, lay in for most part of the straight, gave limited response only.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 留居中間位置，走內疊。直路上大部分途程內閃，對催策反應僅屬平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W1W1W) From wide draw taken across behind runners, raced at the rear along the inside, was finishing well but got held up between 150M-50M. Would have finished closer.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘，在馬群之後切入，居後列，走內疊。衝刺良佳，但一百五十米處至五十米處之間受困。本應可跑得更為接近。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off very strongly, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，衝刺凌厲，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, 6 to 7 lengths back, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run until final 50M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置，落後六至七個馬位。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至最後五十米，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W) Jumped awkwardly losing ground settling in last few, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘笨拙，失地，居最後數位之內。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Jumped well, raced in midfield on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。轉入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Crowded at start, rail position in rear of mid-field, ridden along 500m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Broke well, gradually settling just over 2L back in 4th on rail, saved ground turning in for home, one-paced without quickening under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，逐漸居第四位，落後稍逾兩個馬位，走內欄。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。在催策下保持同速，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Driven along after the start but failed to show sufficient pace going forward, ended up racing behind mid-division, couldn't make up ground in the straight. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步後受催策，但未能展現足夠前速上前，居中間之後位置。直路上未能追前。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked top of home straight, stayed on strongly, in control final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初加速。保持勁勢，最後一百米控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘一般，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders against rail, short of room on bend, ridden top of home straight, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路彎空位不足。直路初受催策。末段保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W5W) Reserved in a rearward spot 6-7Ls off leader in a genuinely run race, pushed along 500M, ran home well enough but had too much to make up on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W5W) 留居後列，落後領放馬六至七個馬位，賽事步速偏快。五百米處受推策，末段衝刺良佳，但已落後領先馬匹甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, driven middle stages, switched for clear run top of home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。中段受催策。直路初轉換跑線以望空。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Waited with towards rear, ridden top of home straight, ran on well final 200m, beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初受催策。最後二百米走勢良佳，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W) Unable to slot in from draw 7, caught racing wide no cover behind midfield, responded mildly to pressure passing 300M, stayed on without posing serious threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W) 自第七檔出閘後未能切入內疊，居中間之後位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。跑過三百米處時對催策反應普通。末段保持走勢，未能對領先馬匹構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, briefly impeded 1100m out, angled wide for clear run into home straight, strong run to lead final 50m, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W3W) 居中間位置。千一米處一度受阻礙。入直路時向外移出以望空。走勢強勁，五十米處取得領先。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Commenced well, raced 3 wide slightly better than midfield, no cover for the majority of the race, showed some response early in straight, unbalanced and blundered near 200M, ran on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走第三疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路初對催策略為交出反應。接近二百米處時失去平衡及失蹄。保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Out in line, sent forward to raced prominently on the outside, there to turn, peaked 250M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。二百五十米處未能再增速，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, travelled in mid-pack along the fence, kept on steadily in the straight without posing threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內欄。直路上保持穩勢，未能威脅領先馬匹。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Bivouac from Maternal, a daughter of Street Cry. Horses by the same sire include Absolute Heart and Ace Eagle. This fellow had seven starts for three wins (a 2yo maiden over 1200m, a 2yo handicap over 1300m and a handicap over 1200m). The fellow was given two trials for a win in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he raced handily and won by 3/4L under slight pressure, over 1000m on turf at Happy Valley on October 9. He looks like a player here at the first time of asking.
formguide.comments_chi: 「露營友」(Bivouac)之後，在港同父馬包括「超和平」及「祥勝鷹駒」，生母出自「街頭口號」(Street Cry)。來港前在澳洲七戰得三勝，頭馬包括一場1200米兩歲從未勝出馬賽、一場1300米兩歲讓磅賽及一場1200米讓磅賽。抵港後兩次試閘得一勝。最近10月9日出試谷草1000米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下以0.75個馬位之先勝出。初出有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W) 自外檔出閘後留後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。以佳勢上前，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Ridden along the rail to be up with the pace before settling one back in 3rd on rail inside the 700M, soon came to tackle leaders on straightening holding every chance despite tight run 150M out and only to be denied narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 沿欄受催策，跟隨領放馬。七百米處居第三位，落後一個馬位，走內欄。入直路時瞬即追趕領先馬匹，儘管一百五十米處緊迫競跑，但已獲機會盡展所長。僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 受催策上前領放。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, nothing extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, showed good speed to lead, ridden 300m out, headed 100m out and faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，展現甚快前速領放。三百米處受催策。一百米處被超越，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W3W) Caught racing wide no cover behind the pacesetters, fought hard to stay in contention early straight, lacked the extra from 200M and was only battling from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初力拼以保持爭勝機會。自二百米處起再無餘力，僅能勉力而為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Midfield early before gaining to share 4th about 1000M out, became 4th outright some 2L back when tempo slackened about 800M out, kept on steadily without quickening in straight and swamped inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 早段居中間位置，約一千米處上前居並列第四位。約八百米處步速減慢時仍居第四位，落後約兩個馬位。直路上保持穩勢，未能加速。最後一百米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Began awkwardly and bumped, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘笨拙，碰撞對手。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Always well back, saved ground on rail into straight, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 沿途遙居於後。入直路時走內欄節省腳程。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W2W) Began well from the one draw settling just off the pace in 3rd, drifted further off the lead to over 2L back in 4th 600M out, weakened under pressure inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居領放馬稍後第三位。六百米處進一步墮居第四位，落後領放馬逾兩個馬位。最後二百米在催策下轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Stayed close enough behind leaders, held up for clear running 300M to 100M before fading away final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 保持落後領先馬匹不遠。三百米處至一百米處之間受困而未能望空。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Awkward start, raced very wide without cover throughout, ridden top of home straight, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 出閘笨拙，沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初受催策。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W) Blundered badly on jumping with jockey becoming unbalanced and the horse losing ground, settled near rear throughout and couldn't go on turning into the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W) 躍出時嚴重失蹄，導致騎師失去平衡，失地。沿途居後列。轉入直路時無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W3W) Bumped and became unbalanced at the start, settled towards the rear 6Ls away, wide into the straight but couldn't finish off when asked. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞及失去平衡，居後列，落後六個馬位。入直路時走外疊，但在催策下衝刺乏力。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W1W2W) Bumped heavily shortly after start, raced towards rear on the inside, moved a bit closer on turn, angled out 400M, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W1W2W) 起步後不久被大力碰撞，居後列，走內疊。直路彎略為追近。四百米處向外移出。衝刺平穩。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W4W) Tracked leaders, taken wide into home straight, quickened early to lead 200m out but soon headed by winner, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時移出外疊。直路初加速，二百米處取得領先，但瞬即被頭馬超越。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Showed good early speed to lead, kept on nicely to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 早段展現甚快前速，取得領先。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W) From a wide draw shifted across behind runners to the rail, raced ungenerously early stages, badly held up rounding the home bend, flashed home once clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後在馬群之後切入內欄。早段走勢欠順。轉直路彎時嚴重受困。末段望空後隨即以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Ridden in first few early settling just over 1L off the pace in 3rd, gained 2nd 600M out 2-wide and hit the front over 200M out, hung on well under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 早段受催策，居前列第三位，落後領放馬稍逾一個馬位。六百米處進佔第二位，走第二疊。二百米處取得領先。在催策下保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, three wide into home straight, stayed on for pressure, couldn't quite reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時走第三疊。在催策下保持走勢，但未能真正追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, sat midfield, held up making the Turn, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。轉直路彎時受困。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W5W) Mid-field, brief effort 400m out, soon flattened out, no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W5W) 居中間位置。四百米處一度發力，瞬即洩氣。未能威脅領先馬匹。

raceinfo_chi.Course: B 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Waited with towards rear, still in rear top of home straight, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。未能望空直至二百米處。最後二百米以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Waited with in rear, blocked off when going for run 350m out, clear run 300m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。三百五十米處取位時受困。三百米處望空，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out after passing 400M, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。跑過四百米處後向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, found daylight near 200M, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。接近二百米處時望空，末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced towards rear on the outside, similar position on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, kept on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時向內斜跑，發生觸碰，居後列，走外疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初略為追前，一百五十米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back, there to turn, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，落後三至四個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Blundered after the start, settled towards the rear, 5Ls to make up 400M, stayed on steadily to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 起步後失蹄，居後列。四百米處落後五個馬位。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, raced near last in a fast run race, held up on the Home Turn and also had difficulty obtaining clear running 200M, did best work late and just missed 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，在快步速下居接近包尾位置。直路彎受困。二百米處也難以望空。以末段表現最佳，僅失季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Sat worse than midfield, improving from the 500M, stayed on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 居中間之後位置。自五百米處起推進。末段保持勁勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Not hurried and raced in second half of the field throughout in a fast run race, urged along 450M, picked up well to challenge for the lead mid-straight but no match for winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 留力候上，沿途在快步速下居後半馬群中。四百五十米處受催策。加速良佳，直路中段爭奪領先，但末段不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths back, same position on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，落後三個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Began fairly gradually settling in 4th mainly about 3L off the pace, came to challenge inside the 350M reaching 2L 2nd briefly inside the 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘一般，逐漸居第四位，大多落後領放馬約三個馬位。三百五十米處上前展開挑戰。二百米處一度進佔第二位，落後兩個馬位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W2W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, briefly hampered 1600m out, shuffled back mid-race, wide into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。千六米處一度受阻礙。中段墮後。入直路時走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W5W) Settled well behind and waited with, commenced move approaching final turn to be one of the widest into home straight, made significant progress to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W5W) 遙居於後，留力候上。趨近直路彎時開始上前。入直路時為走最外疊的馬匹之一。追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, didn't travel with much fluency throughout, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。沿途走勢欠順。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Wide in mid-field without cover, pushed along into home straight, no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時受推策。未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W3W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，碰撞對手，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走第二疊。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, switched and driven along to chase leaders 500m out, ran on well and just lost second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處轉換跑線及受催策以追趕領先馬匹。以佳勢上前，僅失亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, taken wider on bend, quickened early in home straight to lead 250m out, on top from there, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎移出較外疊。直路早段加速，二百五十米處取得領先。其後帶返終點，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped fairly, settled further back than intended in second half of the field, raced 3-wide without cover before closing off mildly final 300M. Not reached leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘一般，居較預期為後的後半馬群之中，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。最後三百米衝刺一般。未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, restrained to race behind midfield, taken out to a 3-wide spot 600M, kept on steadily final 400M for 3rd but was no threat to the runaway winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，受約束，居中間之後位置。六百米處向外移至第三疊。最後四百米保持穩勢，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅遙遙領先的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, blundered 400m out, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。四百米處失蹄。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W5W) Crowded shortly after start, raced towards rear on the outside, moved a bit closer on turn, very wide turning in, made some progress early in straight, no extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W5W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。直路初略為追前。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W2W) Clean jump, raced in 2nd, a length back, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked on run 100M, ran on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W2W) 出閘俐落，居第二位，落後一個馬位。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Lowered its head as stalls opened and lost ground, in rear, severely checked 1400m out, had to wait for run turning into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 開閘時將頭低俯，失地，居後列。千四米處大力勒避。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。末段未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W3W) Reserved behind midfield, pace very slow first half of the race, switched away from fence 400M, ran on steadily to the line without threatening first three.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W3W) 留居中間之後位置，賽事前半段步速非常緩慢。自四百米處起移離內欄。末段以穩勢上前，但未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Settled in midfield, gained 6th into back straight about 4L back, swung one of the widest into straight, responded well inside final 200M to hit the front 100M out and soon kicked clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。入對面直路時進佔第六位，落後約四個馬位。入直路時向外移出，為走最外疊的馬匹之一。最後二百米對催策反應良佳。一百米處取得領先，瞬即帶離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W5W) Held up near last in a strongly run race, pushed along 550M, brought wide for his challenge but failed to come on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W5W) 留居接近包尾位置，賽事步速甚快。五百五十米處受推策。移出外疊展開挑戰，但未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Broke well, gradually settled just over 2L off the pace, crowded 600M out and further away from lead when pace quickened home bend, saved ground into straight, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 出閘迅速，逐漸居領放馬之後稍逾兩個馬位。六百米處受擠迫。直路彎步速加快時落後領放馬更遠。入直路時走內疊節省腳程。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, disputed led middle stages, led again 600m out, headed 250m out, weakened quickly final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。中段爭奪領先，六百米處再度領先。二百五十米處被超越，最後一百五十米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W4W) Gradually settled in midfield 3-wide with cover, commenced move 400M out swinging one of the widest into straight, ran on under pressure but swamped for a placing inside final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 逐漸居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。四百米處開始上前。入直路時向外移出，為走最外疊的馬匹之一。在催策下上前，但最後五十米被超越，失去一席位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, raced in 3rd, 2 lengths or so back, same position on turn, kept on well until approaching final 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居第三位，落後約兩個馬位。直路彎居相同位置。保持佳勢直至趨近一百米處，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W2W) Moved up to race outside the lead and pressed leader during the event, weakened final 200M and was eased when no chance. (Jockey - raced too keenly and couldn't finish off in the straight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 上前居領放馬外側。陣上追迫領放馬。最後二百米轉弱。在爭勝無望時收慢。（騎師表示，坐騎過於搶口，因而在直路上未能以勁勢衝刺。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, showed good speed to lead, challenged by rivals top of home straight, gave ground final 150m.
(Lost right hind plate.)
(Sustained a minor abrasion to its right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a minor abrasion to its right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，展現甚快前速領放。直路初被對手挑戰。最後一百五十米墮退。
（失去右後蹄的蹄鐵。）
（右後腿輕微擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Made all, showed speed to get across, kicked top of home straight, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 帶頭，展現前速以切入。直路初加速。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (4W2W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(4W2W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持走勢，直至最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W1W) Jumped well from gate 10, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W1W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Did not show sufficient pace to lead the event, took a trailing spot behind leader, had to be pushed along 500M, faded final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 未能展現足夠前速領放，居領放馬之後有遮擋的位置。五百米處須受推策。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after leaving stalls, showed good speed to lead, headed 250m out, weakened close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘後不久發生碰撞。展現甚快前速領放。二百五十米處被超越。接近終點時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W1W) Sat in behind the leaders 4th, remained close enough turning for home but lacked a finishing kick, weakened final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W1W) 居領先馬匹之後的第四位。轉直路彎時仍居接近位置，但未能加速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W2W) Pressed forward from the widest draw travelling 3-wide around first bend, came to join race leader turning into back straight, disputed lead into home straight holding every chance until inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策上前。轉首個彎位時走第三疊。轉入對面直路時追上領放馬，進入直路時爭奪領先，保持爭勝機會至一百米處。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W2W2W) Bumped start, raced in 2nd, a length or so back, shared lead from 600M, peaked and headed 200M, weakened and eased final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居第二位，落後約一個馬位。自六百米處起並排領先。二百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱，收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W3W4W) Sat at the rear, never in contention. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W3W4W) 居後列。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back, saved ground on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，落後三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W5W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, angled out 550M, 4-1/2L back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W5W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處向外移出。入直路時落後四個半馬位，直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W2W2W2W) Sat outside the leader, under pressure from the 600M, weakened soon after. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。自六百米處起受催策，其後瞬即轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W3W) Settled in 5th spot ahead of midfield, driven out near 400M, ran on well to be nearest at the line. Just missed 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W3W) 居中間之前第五位。接近四百米處時受力策。走勢良佳，過終點時最為接近。僅失亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Settled down 2-wide in midfield just over 4Ls away, little change in position to the straight, stayed on well final 300M to be nearest at the line. Beaten only 0.5L into 6th in a blanket finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置，落後稍逾四個馬位，走第二疊。直路前位置大致不變。最後三百米保持佳勢。過終點時最為接近，在多駒幾乎齊過終點下取得第六名，僅以半個馬位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Away with them, raced behind midfield on the outside, commenced move 400M, 4 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to take 2nd, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走外疊。四百米處開始上前，入直路時落後四個馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得亞軍，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Sluggish at start, soon made good headway on rail to rear of midfield in 7th, saved ground turning in for home, one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 起步緩慢，瞬即沿欄追前頗多，居中間之後第七位。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Hampered 1300M out, settled behind midfield on rail, came under pressure home bend, steadied between runners 250M out, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 千三米處受阻礙，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受催策。二百五十米處在馬匹之間收慢。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Raced in rear after crowded at start, lost balance 1000m out, dropped to last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，其後居後列。一千米處失去平衡。直路初墮居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat at the rear on the fence, saved ground, not much clear room in the Straight, not fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。直路上未能望空，未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Taken back to race 3 wide behind midfield, moved a bit closer on turn, made good progress early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 留居中間之後位置，走第三疊。直路彎略為追近。直路早段追前頗多。一百米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Away with them, positioned 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back, there to turn, closed off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，落後約四個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped with them, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路上略為追前，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Raced in touch with leaders, pushed along wide into home straight, bumped 450m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 緊隨領先馬匹。入直路時受推策，走外疊。四百五十米處與對手互相碰撞。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W2W) Settled at the back from a wide draw and waited with, made up good ground under pressure in home straight though never threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後居後列，留力候上。直路上在催策下追前甚多，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last place top of home straight, did not get best of runs in home straight when trying to improve, eye-catching finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮退。直路初仍居包尾位置。直路上嘗試推進時取位不太暢順。以悅目走勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, short-lived effort to challenge leader top of home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。直路初一度發力，挑戰領放馬。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made running from stall 1, controlled race from front, led by 2L+ into home straight, ran on strongly to extend advantage.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘後帶頭，在領放下主宰步速。入直路時領先逾兩個馬位。末段走勢強勁，擴大領先優勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Settled toward rear, pulled forward slightly before steadied when keen about 950M out, saved ground on the inside turning in for home but did not find much room early in straight until the 200M, one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居後列，其後略為追前。約九百五十米處搶口時收慢。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程，但直路初空位不足直至二百米處。其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W4W) Very slowly away losing considerable ground, recovered steadily to join the rear of the field over 900M out, commenced move angling off the rail 600M out, ran on from 4L 9th into straight to just fail to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W4W) 出閘十分緩慢，失地甚多。其後逐漸恢復走勢，九百米處追上馬群後列。六百米處移離內欄，開始上前。入直路時落後四個馬位，居第九位，其後追前，過終點時僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Slightly slow out, raced 3 wide slightly behind midfield, moved closer after passing 1200M, no cover from 900M, 1 to 2 lengths back on turn, hard ridden approaching 300M but only showed limited response, weakened gradually final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘稍慢，居中間稍後位置，走第三疊。跑過千二米處後追近。自九百米處起沒有遮擋。直路彎落後一至兩個馬位。趨近三百米處時受力策，但反應僅屬一般。最後五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly from gate 1, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader on the inside, made contact near 600M, same position on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走內疊。接近六百米處時與對手互相觸碰。直路彎居相同位置。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Crowded at start and soon taken across at the back for rails run, travelled keenly on heels from the 600M, obtained a clear run switching onto inside 300M out, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 起步時受擠迫，瞬即在馬群之後切入內欄。自六百米處起搶口，緊貼他駒後蹄。三百米處移向內疊以望空。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Hampered on rail 1300M out, travelled in forward of midfield in 5th of stretched field on rail, saved ground on the inside turning in for home but soon weakened under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 千三米處受阻礙，走內欄，居分散馬群中間之前第五位，走內欄。入直路時走內疊節省腳程，但在催策下瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Taken back to race at rear on the outside, 7 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after leaving stalls, under pressure 500m out, unable to quicken, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘後不久發生碰撞。五百米處受催策。未能加速，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 2 obtained a midfield position along the fence, held up on the home turn but failed to finish off when asked in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第二檔出閘，居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎受困，但在直路上在催策下未能以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) From wide draw dropped back to race in last, had plenty to do 400M, couldn't improve.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。四百米處落後甚遠。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W3W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Positioned ahead of midfield, held his position to home turn, under the pump 400M but soon gave way. (Jockey - did not run out 1800M in his opinion.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置。保持位置至直路彎。四百米處受催策，但瞬即墮退。（騎師表示，他認為坐騎未能應付千八米途程。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Shared early pace from a wide barrier before settling 2-wide in joint or outright 2nd, unable to sustain effort and swamped inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，早段並排領先，其後並列或單騎居第二位，走第二疊。末段無以為繼，最後一百五十米被後上馬群超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Shifted in at start and bumped, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但末段未能抗衡首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Made all, kicked 400m out and soon in command, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 沿途領放。四百米處加速，瞬即控制大局。末段距離收窄，但保持領放至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Raced prominently, challenged 300m out, led 150m out, in control final 50m and comfortable winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居前列。三百米處展開挑戰。一百五十米處取得領先。最後五十米控制大局，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W7W) Jumped awkwardly from a poor draw settling well back, shifted widest at the back into straight, produced good impression early in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W7W) 自第十二檔出閘笨拙，遙居於後。入直路時在馬群後方移出最外疊。直路早段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W1W1W) Settled at the rear, held up from the 200m, not able to pick up once clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W1W1W) 居後列。自二百米處起受困。望空後未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Settled worse than midfield 3 wide, made minor progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。略為追前。
